headline: Re-estimated on 2000-2024 successor data with the paper's own 1816-2000 war history (X1, the designated headline estimate), the external-war correlate PERSISTS between regions (significant in all 8 outcomes, standardized beta 0.24 vs 0.19 in the paper's era) but WEAKENS within regions (3/8); on the paper's own pre-1975 reconstruction, X0 between: weakens (3/8), reconstruction-degraded (corr 0.61 with the authors' avg_war00); legal origin persists, parliamentary democracy weakens, and democracy becomes a new out-of-sample predictor.

notes: Branch R (reconstruction; deposit pending): no AER.dta and no Phase-1 estimate file on disk, so paper-era anchors are the PRINTED cells and the 12-cell suspect set plus fn17 is reported pending-deposit (no typo adjudicated, no suspect-cell stars used as evidence).

Paper-era standardized anchors for the attenuation clause were reconstructed in-study (X0 spec on GFDD/V-Dem/GRD 1980-2000) because no Phase-1 estimate file exists; NBER w13028 WP not staged so the typo-table WP cross-check column is unavailable.

Doing Business was discontinued in September 2021 after data-irregularity findings; cols 2-3 (Y2/Y3) are bridge columns outside all verdict counts for that reason. Y6 (Hanson-Sigman) ends 2015. WGI rule of law (Y4) is partially ICRG-fed, so it is a successor to, not an independent check on, the paper's ICRG column; raw ICRG excluded (proprietary).
X2 (UCDP-spliced war to 2024) is descriptive (contemporaneous-war caveat) and never enters a verdict.

These are conditional cross-country correlations, exactly as the paper itself labels its evidence (pp. 1235, 1241); nothing here is causal, and no verdict below upgrades or downgrades the paper's causal claims, because it made none.

Novelty: the first re-estimation of the AER 2009 Tables 1-2 specification (external-war incidence 1816-1975 + democracy and parliamentary-democracy incidence to 1975 + legal origins, on the paper's outcome battery or its successors) on any post-publication data, and the first grading of those patterns out of sample (checked against the update's published do-files and dataset; literature search 2026-11-05).
